The '''Merson pirates''', sometimes called the '''Merson Slavers''', were a band of [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] active in the [[Merson asteroid belt]] during the final decades of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==History==
A band of criminals, the Merson pirates patrolled the [[Merson asteroid belt]] looking for [[Starship/Legends|starships]] to attack during the final days of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. The group had known ties to the [[Zygerrian/Legends|Zygerrians]], a species notorious for their massive [[Zygerrian Slave Empire/Legends|slave empire]]. Since the asteroid field made [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] travel impossible, any craft that traveled the area had to drift through the field hoping to avoid detection. The pirates would wait for passing civilian cruisers, attacking them with little chance of resistance since luxury craft were usually minimally armed.<ref name="HNN46">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|46|regional/1337_5.html|Merson Pirates Attack Sy Myrth Liner}}</ref>

During the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]], a time of political turmoil in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]], the pirates attacked and scuttled the [[Sy Myrthian/Legends|Sy Myrthian]] [[Passenger liner/Legends|passenger liner]], the ''[[Elegant Wake]]''. The fate of all 456 registered passengers was unknown, but the news report on the incident speculated that they had been taken as [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]]. Relatives of the passengers attempted to bring a suit for damages against the liner's operator, [[Romodi Interstellar]]. However, the recent secession of [[Sy Myrth/Legends|Sy Myrth]] from the Republic created bureaucratic issues regarding their access to [[Republic courts]].<ref name="HNN46" />

The following year the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] erupted between the Republic and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] and the pirates went unchecked. During this time of conflict, [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] escorted a [[pleasure cruiser]] through the belt, defending the ship from the pirates.<ref name="Star Wars 1977 24">[[Star Wars (1977) 24|''Star Wars'' (1977) 24]]</ref>
